business_problem: PwC wanted to modernize finance operations across multiple territories with a shared cloud ERP foundation that could strengthen controls, simplify reporting, and let finance teams apply embedded AI to document handling and other processes without adding more manual work.
solution_summary: PwC rolled Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP out across multiple territories to standardize finance processes for approximately 34,000 employees and to create a platform where predictive, generative, and agentic AI could be applied inside core accounting workflows. Oracle Cloud ERP becomes the system of record for reporting, controls, and planning alignment, while the document IO agent automates document handling across finance processes. Rather than treating AI as a separate pilot, PwC is using Oracle's embedded AI capabilities directly in transactional finance work so teams can reduce touch points, move information faster, and generate more timely insights. The internal deployment also acts as a proving ground that informs PwC's client delivery methods, accelerators, and implementation approaches for organizations looking to modernize finance with cloud ERP and AI.
products_used: Oracle Fusion Cloud Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)
Oracle Cloud ERP document IO agent
